drafted_from: tool:search-mixkit-for-free-sound-effects row in tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/tool-rows.json, its script in tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/ and tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/test/test_judge_sound_effects.py (run for real on made-up tones)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Search Mixkit for sound effects tagged click that last at most 2 seconds and write /work/sfx/mk-candidates.json." It runs the Mixkit search and tells you how many it found per category.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads a queries.json on this computer, reads Mixkit's public tag pages and writes a candidates.json file.
instructions: 1. Write /work/sfx/mk-queries.json: {"tick": {"tags": ["click"], "max_s": 2}} (category, the Mixkit tag pages to read, the longest length in seconds).

2. Say "Search Mixkit". The AI reads the row with tools:list and runs: python3 -I tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/search_mixkit.py /work/sfx/mk-queries.json /work/sfx/mk-candidates.json (it needs the internet and waits 1.5 s between requests).
3. Read the last line (count per category), then open mk-candidates.json for each item's id, title, duration, tag page and WAV address; a tag page that does not exist is reported and skipped.
4. Choose items and pass them to tool:fetch-free-sound-effects-with-their-licences.

worked_examples.title: Tag click gives one short sound; a long one and a missing tag page are left out
worked_examples.ask: Search Mixkit for click sounds under 2 seconds.
worked_examples.given: From tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/test/test_judge_sound_effects.py (test_freesound_and_mixkit_searches_keep_each_item_once_within_its_length, made-up Mixkit page): mk-queries.json is {"tick": {"tags": ["click", "gone"], "max_s": 2}}; the click page lists "Small click" (0:01, id 501) and "Long hum" (1:05, id 502); the gone page answers HTTP 404. Command: python3 -I tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/search_mixkit.py /work/sfx/mk-queries.json /work/sfx/mk-candidates.json
worked_examples.hands_back: It prints "tick: click -> 1" and "tick: gone -> HTTP 404", then the last line {"result": {"out": "/work/sfx/mk-candidates.json", "counts": {"tick": 1}}}. mk-candidates.json tick[0] is {"id": 501, "title": "Small click", "duration_s": 1, "tag_page": "https://mixkit.co/free-sound-effects/click/", "wav_url": "https://assets.mixkit.co/active_storage/sfx/501/501.wav"}.
